title: Gemini Enterprise, zero to hero
subtitle: Google's agentic platform, end to end
channel: Google Cloud, Google for Developers and 11 others
description: Forty-nine videos in a teaching order: what Gemini Enterprise is, how it relates to Vertex AI and the Agentspace it replaced, turning it on, grounding it in company data, then agents — no-code first, then ADK, MCP and A2A, multi-agent systems, governance, and what it takes to run one in production.

title: دورة رد الشبهات
subtitle: Responding to Doubts
description: A 33-lesson course on recognising and answering doubts raised about Islam, wrapped in a tracker that keeps watch progress, ratings, tags, notes and per-video annotations in the browser.
